package_info.why_malicious: This report does not describe a malicious package or code. Instead, it discusses a protocol-level vulnerability (CVE-2023-44487, HTTP/2 'Rapid Reset') affecting multiple open source projects. The vulnerability enables attackers to conduct high-volume DDoS attacks by abusing the HTTP/2 protocol's implementation, but there is no mention of intentionally malicious code or malware in any package.

behavioral_signatures: Unusually high volume of HTTP/2 RST_STREAM frames
Rapid opening and resetting of HTTP/2 streams
Sudden spikes in HTTP/2 request rates
network_indicators: Massive number of HTTP/2 connections with rapid resets
Abnormal HTTP/2 traffic patterns targeting web servers
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor HTTP/2 traffic for patterns of rapid stream resets (RST_STREAM frames) and abnormally high request rates. Use network-level DDoS detection tools to identify volumetric attacks exploiting the HTTP/2 protocol. There are no file-based or code-based indicators, as this is a protocol abuse rather than a malware infection.
